current_evidence: Neither the county's 'Applying for planning permission' page nor its 'planningforms' page links a local validation list. Three searches turned up only district lists (Warwick, Stratford, North Warwickshire) and other counties' minerals/waste checklists, so no published WCC list was found within budget.

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is a generic 'Applying for planning permission' web page, not a validation list. It covers pre-application charging schedules, application forms and a Planning Portal link, and contains no list of local information requirements.
issues.evidence: Page text: 'Please contact us and we can advise you about which forms we will need'; links only to pre-app charging schedule, pre-app fees, pre-app request form and the mineral working application form

issues.detail: The workbook status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is misleading. The page loads and can be read; the problem is that the county does not appear to publish a local validation list for county matter (minerals/waste) or Regulation 3 applications. The row should say 'no published local list found' rather than suggest a fetch failure, so users don't assume a list exists behind the link.
issues.evidence: warwickshire.gov.uk/planningforms: minerals and waste applications go to WCC; forms and EIA guidance listed, but no validation checklist

issues.detail: Every app-type row (Householder, Full planning, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, etc.) says 'Not covered: local list link found but not readable'. As a county planning authority, WCC only determines Minerals & waste (county) and County own development (Reg 3) applications, so the district-type rows are not applicable rather than 'not readable'.
issues.evidence: planningforms page: 'Residential, industrial or commercial development applications' go to the relevant district or borough council

summary: The workbook link is a generic county 'Applying for planning permission' page, not a validation list, and no published Warwickshire County Council local validation list was found on the county site or by search. Grokbot's 'blocked/404/login' status is wrong (the page loads fine), and the district-type app rows should be marked not applicable.
